premises.text: Developers need cross-platform backends for data sync; current choices are limited, slow, or costly to scale
premises.evidence_span: to have data sync across different devices, they first need a back end

premises.text: Backend uses Dropbox/Google Drive personal clouds to store and instantly sync app data across web and mobile
premises.evidence_span: once both apps are authorized on your Dropbox account, data is instantly synced between the two

premises.text: Local-first offline storage then cloud sync is the default persistence path
premises.evidence_span: that data is first stored locally and then synced to be online when you do have a connection

premises.text: Users can personally delete app data from their cloud, unlike opaque social-network servers
premises.evidence_span: you can personally delete your data for your apps

premises.text: Removes the developer's server: setup in minutes and no storage hosting costs at any scale
premises.evidence_span: we completely remove the server from the app development equation

domains.name: Serverless cost and time for developers

value.text: Solve data continuity across devices via personal cloud as application backend
